public_summary: Full current-WELP recharacterization of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 4B (Q4_K_M, llama.cpp b10449 SM120, RTX 5070 12GB), executed 2026-09-11, appending the preserved 2026-08-25 PROTOCOL_BLOCKED historical record.
